items.text: Falcons edge Za'Darius Smith (shoulder, Q) should be good to go vs Steelers today barring setback, per source.
items.implication: ATL defense closer to full; minor for fantasy but confirms no further cascade.

items.text: Giants WR Malik Nabers listed QUESTIONABLE (knee); team elevated WR Braxton Berrios and signed WR Dalen Cambre from PS as contingency.
items.why: Recovery from prior ACL; final decision left to player; full practices but caution.
items.implication: GTD for SNF vs DAL; if OUT, major target vacuum for Likely/others.
items.opportunity: If OUT: elevated routes/targets for Isaiah Likely, Malachi Fields, etc.

items.text: Falcons QB Tua Tagovailoa OUT (oblique); Cooper Rush experienced back spasms Saturday but team confirms he will still start vs Steelers. Penix also OUT.
items.why: Tua oblique from practice; Rush spasms but cleared to start.
items.implication: Limited ATL offense efficiency; impacts London/Bijan ceiling slightly via QB play.
items.opportunity: Potential for more conservative script or checkdowns; monitor Bijan/London usage.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers ruled OUT for Week 1 after meniscus trim procedure; expected to miss a game or two. Officially confirmed Saturday.
items.why: Meniscus trim surgery mid-week after camp bang-up.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in LV passing game; elevates Jeanty as focal point and opens TE targets for Mayer or others.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/targets for Jeanty; WR/TE snap share expansion for remaining pass-catchers.

items.text: Patriots officially placed WR A.J. Brown on injured reserve; signed DT DaQuan Jones.
items.implication: Season-long absence start; NE WR corps thinned, elevates others in short term.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining NE WRs/TEs.

items.text: ETR/Thorman Week 1 Snaps & Pace (updated for Tua/Bowers): Up in pace NO@DET; slow-paced slog MIA@LV. CHI/CAR total jumped. Full report live.
items.why: Pace projections adjusted for injuries (Tua OUT, Bowers OUT); historical/team tendencies.
items.implication: Favor volume plays in NO-DET; fade pure pace in MIA-LV.
items.opportunity: Higher neutral snaps expected NO/DET; lower MIA/LV.

items.text: Matthew Berry contrarian: CMC is a BUY LOW despite preseason usage concerns and Kaelon Black looking good. Banged up preseason, long flight, weird game—not worried.
items.why: Preseason context (injury, travel, weird game) explains muted looks; still elite.
items.implication: Start with confidence; buy-low window if market overreacts to Week 0/preseason.
items.opportunity: Expect full workhorse role snaps/carries/targets ROS and Week 1.

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze QUESTIONABLE (calf); limited all week. Other CHI Qs include Bagent.
items.implication: If OUT/limited, more work for Burden, Moore, Loveland in CHI@CAR.
items.opportunity: Route/target share expansion for remaining CHI pass-catchers.

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara QUESTIONABLE (knee/MCL); full participant Friday but status uncertain for DET. Estime OUT.
items.why: MCL sprain recovery; full Friday practice.
items.implication: If limited/OUT, Etienne/Neal see expanded role in up-tempo NO@DET.
items.opportunity: Potential full/near-full snaps if plays; else handcuff upside for backups.

items.text: Cowboys RB Malik Davis OUT (hip) after Friday practice injury; impacts DAL depth behind Javonte.
items.implication: Javonte Williams locked as workhorse; no handcuff depth short-term.
items.opportunity: Near 100% RB snaps/carries for Javonte Williams.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty officially off injury report and good to go/active for Week 1 vs Dolphins after full practices all week post-ankle sprain.
items.why: Full participant Wed-Fri; self-reported feeling really good/100%.
items.implication: High-end RB2 with possible managed workload early but primary backfield role, especially with Bowers out.
items.opportunity: Vast majority of RB touches expected; upside as offense focal point.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Isaiah Likely ranks 4th in FPP target among TEs last 3 yrs; 8/9 games with 6+ targets = 12.5+ PPR. Nabers won't be 100%; Giants WR2 is Fields/Mooney. Gimme all the Likely.
items.why: Elite per-target efficiency + Nabers uncertainty creates opportunity.
items.implication: Strong TE start/stream especially if Nabers limited/OUT.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share if Nabers not full go.

items.text: Berry on Chuba Hubbard: flex play this week but viable; 'keeping it open' on The Chubbler amid Brooks return/clearance.
items.why: Viable flex despite committee risk with Brooks cleared.
items.implication: Startable flex; monitor split with Jonathon Brooks.
items.opportunity: Shared carries but still solid volume in CAR backfield.

items.text: Eagles TE Eli Stowers downgraded to OUT and placed on IR (quad/hamstring).
items.implication: Goedert more locked-in TE1 snaps; less TE depth.
items.opportunity: Higher snap share for Dallas Goedert.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Since joining PHI, Saquon Barkley vs WAS (4 games incl playoffs): 136.5 rush yds, 6.0 YPC, 21+ PPR every time. WAS front still below-average.
items.why: Historical dominance vs this matchup + defensive projection.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Herbert FPP/PA 52% higher with Joe Alt on field last year. Alt healthy. Cards DL ranked 31st, secondary 26th, pressure rate 27th by PFF.
items.why: OL health + soft ARI pass rush/secondary matchup.
items.implication: Strong QB1 upside Week 1 vs ARI.
items.opportunity: Higher efficiency/volume potential for Herbert and LAC pass-catchers.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Olave averaged 29% target share and 14.7+ PPR in 75% of games with Tyler Shough last year. Lions safeties on IR; high O/U.
items.why: Proven chemistry with Shough + soft secondary + pace/total.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Parker Washington when 70%+ routes: 24% target share; career 15%+ TS = 16.4 PPG. Browns CB Ward primarily on Brian Thomas Jr.
items.why: Route/target history + favorable shadow matchup for BTJ frees Washington.
